action.title: action
action.description:
Action to perform on the claims. Supported values:
- approve
- reject

If approving, an approved amount must be provided.

approvedAmount.title: approvedAmount
approvedAmount.description: Amount to be approved for the selected claims. This is required only when the action is "approve". Do not provide this for rejection.

claimNumbers.title: claimNumbers
claimNumbers.description: List of claim numbers to process (e.g., WC-123, WC-456). These should match the claim number (Name) in the system.
